description: Queensland Urban Utilities - Sewer Gravity Main is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Queensland Urban Utilities. This information is from the Queensland Urban Utilities Open Data GIS Map More detailed view of the sewer network is available through the GIS Map. This dataset only includes the Sewer Gravity Main layer. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Infrastructure, Assets, Building and Equipment. Its keywords are Sewer, Utilities, QUU. The portal shows 148,000 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
